description: A `.ts` breakpoint binds inside a stackful async frame, after the resume
notes: The stop is inside game/work$body, a frame that was suspended at `await inner(before)` and resumed by the core loop: `r = 12` is the value `inner` computed for `before = 11`, so the frame's state crossed the suspension. Measured: a breakpoint requested at game.ts:23 or :24 resolves to game.ts:24, and one requested at game.ts:21 or :22 resolves to game.ts:22 (the pre-suspension await line) - so :23 is not separately observable in this JIT image. `before` and `after` report no location at this stop (both are consumed on the line above), which is the same live-range contract add-locals asserts; `x` is the parameter and `r` the resumed callee's result. `maxStops: 1`: continuing past this stop makes the consumer report extra SIGTRAP/SIGSEGV stops at the same line (measured on lldb 20.1.4-codelldb + wasmtime 50.0.2 with the jit-loader plugin), so the fixture asserts the stop and leaves the process there. wasmtime 50.0.2 is pinned per fixture because the harness default, 24.0.13, cannot parse a continuation type at all (`invalid leading byte (0x5d) for type`) and has no -W stack-switching option.
